newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck expects clear profit rise in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Merck expects clear profit rise in 1996.

text.p: German pharmaceutical company Merck KGaA expects to report clearly higher earnings for full-year 1996, its management board chairman Hans Joachim Langmann said at Merck's nine-month results on Wednesday.

"There is no question that we will again report increased earnings in full-year 1996. Even if we just added one third of what we've earned already this year that would be a growth of around 30 percent," said Langmann.
Langmann said that the group was also confident for 1997, as the pharmaceutical sector was registering above-average growth.
